8.3.3.28 Dem_SetEventConfirmationThresholdCounter
[SWS_Dem_91004]
Definition of API function Dem_SetEventConfirmation
ThresholdCounter ⌈
Service Name
Dem_SetEventConfirmationThresholdCounter
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dem_SetEventConfirmationThresholdCounter (
Dem_EventIdType EventId,
uint8 FailureCycleCounterThreshold
)
Service ID [hex]
0x57
Sync/Async
Asynchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different EventIds. Non reentrant for the same EventId.
EventId
Identification of an event by assigned EventId.
Parameters (in)
FailureCycleCounter
Threshold
Failure cycle counter threshold of event to be set.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Change of threshold was successful.
E_NOT_OK: Threshold cannot be changed as DemEvent
ConfirmationThresholdCounterAdaptable is set to FALSE for this
event.
Description
Set the failure confirmation threshold of an event.
Available via
Dem.h
